name: trace_symbol
description: Trace a constant or variable's value and find all references including suspected hardcoded literal copies. Use this for constant/variable value tracing (e.g., 'where is MAX_RETRY_COUNT used?'). For function/class impact analysis, use impact_analysis instead. The literals search is text-based with a confidence heuristic. REQUIRED: Call reindex first.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first.

file.description: File path relative to workspace_dir where the symbol is defined (e.g. "src/config.py")

include_literals.description: Search for hardcoded literal values across the project (default: false, slower)
